name: Mishra, Eminent One
oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token that's a copy of target noncreature artifact you control, except its name is Mishra's Warform and it's a 4/4 Construct artifact creature in addition to its other types. It gains haste until end of turn. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token that's a copy of target noncreature artifact you control, except its name is Mishra's Warform and it's a 4/4 Construct artifact creature in addition to its other types.

needs.what: a `name` key in copy_permanent's `except_` (stored in the token's copy_overrides and applied by GameState.card_of), so "create a token that's a copy of X, except its name is Mishra's Warform" sets the name as a copiable value (707.9b) on the token before it enters
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ covers power/toughness, types/add_types, subtypes/add_subtypes, add_keywords, colors and supertypes but not the name; become_copy's except_name only renames a permanent copying in place, not a token copy. The `rename` op applied to the `as` binding afterwards gets close, but it is a non-copiable effect set after the token exists: a copy of Mishra's Warform would come back under the original artifact's name, and the token enters (and its ETB triggers see it) under the copied name. The rest of the line is expressible: except_ {power 4, toughness 4, add_types [Creature], add_subtypes [Construct]}, grant_keyword haste this_turn on the binding, and a delayed_trigger on end_step that sacrifices it
